journal_lines: Good stand of oak. Clean work.
The oak at the center is old enough to matter.
Birch light is different. White bark scatters everything.
Clean, quick work. These trees have nothing to say about it.
An oak old enough to have a name nobody remembers anymore. Took only the lower limbs.
Birch bark peels in long curls. Carried some for the bag liners.
Acorns in the leaf litter, three deep. A good year for the squirrels, or a bad one.
The grove smelled like rain that had not yet fallen.
Sap came up amber where the cut was. Slow, the way good blood comes.
